title: 第2章 第十大盗
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
在楚域，或说南瞻部洲，青云仙道门的弟子，每一个都如神祇一般立于凡域之巅，世间三教九流的帮派势力，在道门弟子面前便如土鸡瓦狗一般，不堪一击。就在三个月前，青云山道门的真传弟子肖剑鸣便曾一人一剑，诛却了鬼烟谷的九大盗匪，只剩一人逃窜。
九大盗匪的脑袋都已经悬在了鬼烟谷口示众，肖剑鸣则除恶务尽，正在雁荡山一带全力追缉最后一名盗匪，据说，那是最神秘的一个盗匪，只闻其名，却无人见过他的模样……
肖剑鸣坚信自己能找到他，也发誓一定要找到他，只是无人知晓，这第十大盗，已经在三个月后拜入了青云道门，成为了他的一名小师弟……如果道童也算师弟的话。
青云道门每十年收一次徒，每次择徒千人，而道童则是时时召收，整体数量过万，名义上，道童也算得青云山的弟子，只是与寻常弟子不同，道童没有每个月的灵药发放，也没有长老专门为他们讲道，每天都要累死累活的干一次杂活，一个月才得休息一天。
所换来的，就是一本薄薄的小册子，名曰：青云锻气篇。
在方行被胖道人领到了一排小木屋，交到了一个脸上生了一个硕大黑痣的十八九岁男子手里后，便狞笑着将一叠青衣，一本小册子，一个铭刻了名字的小木牌交到了他手里。
“练吧，你走了狗屎运，灵云师姐特地发话让你拜入山门，只不过你一无荐信，二无钱财，三无资质，就只能从最底层做起了，这本青云锻气篇，可是我们青云道门的不传之秘，外人难得一见的，你好好修炼，将青云锻气篇炼到了灵动一重，便可以升为外门弟子了……”
胖道人走了，方行看着眼前抱臂在胸前，脸色不善的望着自己的黑痣青年，以及旁边年龄不大，却一个个摆出了老气横秋的**模样的小道童，开口问道：“你们都是多少层？”
黑痣青年人大拇指朝自己一指，狠狠道：“老子已经有了气感，其他人屁都没有！”
方行若有所思的点了点头，又问道：“你们进来多少年了？”
黑痣青年冷笑了一声，道：“老子入门六年了，他们几个也入三年了！”
方行叹了口气，把小册子往旁边一丢，叹道：“看样子老子被那娘们骗了！”
黑痣青年一怔，奇道：“你说的是哪个娘们？”
方行道：“灵云啊，那个娘们说要将我收入山门，谁知道是来干活的，只给了这本破册子，你们几个要么入山七年，要么入山三年，却什么都没有练成，这可不是骗人的么？”
“灵云师姐？”
黑痣青年大吃一惊，急冲上来揪住了方行的领子，狠狠道：“闭嘴，别给老子招祸，被别人听到你这样咒骂灵云师姐，别说是你，就连我们几个也得倒楣！你给我，老子让你抓虫，你就不能撵鸡……”
“对，对，以后的马桶就归你来倒了，还有每天提水，把水缸倒满……”
一个满脸雀斑的小道童附和着说道，看这模样，以前倒马桶提水的估计就是他。
“哼，还有以后的衣服，就是你来洗了，直到有新人过来！”
另一个模样有些白净的道童说道，不用说了，这位就是给人洗衣服的。

方行一个一个的看着他们，若有所思的点了点头，道：“原来你们是在欺负我啊……”
黑痣青年森然笑道：“是又怎么样？”
说着，他嘭的一拳砸在了别边的桌子上，胳膊上青筋毕露，模样凶残。
“你想打我么？我可是会叫的……”
方行状作惊恐的叫道，看样子别人动他一根指头，就要放声大叫。
黑痣青年嘿嘿一笑，道：“别怕，我们现在不动你，只不过到了晚上，门一关，嘿嘿，方圆十里就只有我们这几个人，就算你叫破喉咙，也没人会理你的……”
“对对对，每隔三个月，才会有药司监的师兄过来巡查一遍，其他的时间里，这里可就是我们的天下，而且就算你告我们的状，理事师兄们也不会理会的，他们才没功夫管这些，而你可就倒了大楣，日后的日子长着呢，做了道童，可至少得十年才能下山……”
满脸雀斑的小道童很是兴奋的威胁方行，似乎第一次威胁人，难免有些激动。

content_en:
In the Chu Territory, or Nanzhan Buzhou, every disciple of the Qingyun Immortal Taoist Sect stands on the top of the mortal realm like a god. The gangs and forces of the three religions and nine streams in the world are as vulnerable as chickens and dogs in front of the Taoist disciples. Just three months ago, Xiao Jianming, a true disciple of the Qingyun Mountain Taoist Sect, killed the nine bandits in Ghost Smoke Valley with one sword and one man, leaving only one person to escape.
The heads of the nine major bandits have been hung at the entrance of Guiyan Valley for public display. Xiao Jianming has done his best to eliminate evil and is pursuing the last bandit in the Yandang Mountain area. It is said that he is the most mysterious bandit. He has only heard of his name, but no one has seen his appearance...
Xiao Jianming firmly believed that he could find him and vowed to find him. However, no one knew that the tenth thief had already joined the Qingyun Taoist Sect three months later and became one of his junior disciples...if a Taoist boy could also be considered a junior disciple.
Qingyun Taoist sect accepts disciples every ten years, and each time they select thousands of disciples, while Taoist boys recruit them all the time, with the total number exceeding ten thousand. In name, Taoist boys are also considered disciples of Qingyun Mountain, but they are different from ordinary disciples. Taoist boys do not distribute elixirs every month, and there are no elders to preach specifically for them. They have to do tiring chores every day and only have one day off a month.
What he got in exchange was a thin booklet called: Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter.
After Fang Xing was led by the fat Taoist to a row of cabins and handed over to an eighteen or nineteen-year-old man with a huge black mole on his face, he handed him a stack of green clothes, a pamphlet, and a small wooden sign with his name on it with a grin.
"Practice, you are unlucky. Senior Sister Lingyun specially sent a message to let you join the sect. However, you have no letters of recommendation, no money, and no qualifications, so you can only start from the bottom. This Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter is an untold secret of our Qingyun Taoist sect, and it is rare for outsiders to see it. You practice well, and after you have refined the Qingyun Qi Training Chapter to the first level of agility, you can be promoted to an outer disciple..."
The fat Taoist left. Fang Xing looked at the young man with a black mole in front of him who had his arms folded on his chest and looked at him with an unkind expression, as well as the little Taoist boy next to him who was not very old but had an old-fashioned look, and asked: "What level are you at?"
The young man with the black mole pointed his thumb at himself and said fiercely: "I already have a sense of energy, and the others don't have any!"
Fang Xing nodded thoughtfully and asked, "How many years have you been here?"
The young man with the black mole sneered and said, "I have been here for six years, and they have been here for three years!"
Fang Xing sighed, threw the pamphlet aside, and sighed: "It seems that I was deceived by that bitch!"
The young man with the black mole was startled and asked curiously: "Which girl are you talking about?"
Fang Xingdao: "Lingyun, that girl said she wanted to take me into the mountain gate. Who knew she was here to work? She only gave me this shabby book. You guys have either been in the mountain for seven years or three years, but you haven't mastered anything. Isn't this a lie?"
"Senior Sister Lingyun?"
The young man with the black mole was shocked. He rushed forward and grabbed Fang Xing's collar. He said harshly: "Shut up, don't bring trouble to me. If others hear you cursing Senior Sister Lingyun like this, let alone you, even the rest of us will be in trouble! Just give me a break. I'm asking you to catch bugs, so you can't catch chickens..."
"Yes, yes, from now on you will be responsible for filling the toilet, and you will have to carry water and fill the water tank every day..."
A little Taoist boy with freckles on his face echoed and said, judging from his appearance, he was probably the one who emptied the toilet and fetched water before.
"Hmph, and the clothes from now on, you'll have to wash them until someone new comes over!"
Another fair-looking Taoist boy said, Needless to say, this one washes people's clothes.
Fang Xing looked at them one by one, nodded thoughtfully, and said, "So you are bullying me..."
The young man with the black mole smiled solemnly and said, "So what?"As he said that, he punched the table on the other side with a bang. The veins on his arms were exposed and he looked ferocious.
"Do you want to hit me? I know how to scream..."
Fang Xingzhuo screamed in horror. It seemed that if anyone touched him, he would scream loudly.
The young man with the black mole chuckled and said: "Don't be afraid, we won't touch you now, but at night, when the door is closed, hey, we are the only ones within ten miles. Even if you scream, no one will pay attention to you..."
"Yes, yes, yes, every three months, seniors from the Pharmacy Supervisor will come to inspect. During the rest of the time, this is our world, and even if you file a complaint against us, the senior directors will not pay attention to it. They don't have time to take care of this. But you have failed. You will have a long life in the future. If you become a Taoist boy, it will take at least ten years to get off the mountain..."
The freckle-faced Taoist boy threatened Fang Xing very excitedly. It seemed like it was his first time threatening someone, so he was inevitably a little excited.
